definition: [ זֶ֫מֶר ] noun [masculine] a certain animal allowed as food, most probably some kind of mountain-sheep or -goat ( ᵑ6 ) וָזָמֶ֑ר Deut 14:5 . ( AV RV chamois: but see Tristr DB 2. under the word , who points out that this is not a native of any Bible land.)
